_comment: The expected suite spine for the FridgeLuck overhaul scorecard, from PLAN.md 'The scorecard (evals first)' on docs/spec-overhaul-20261011 (revision 2, 2026-10-11). Suites are run from evaluation/suites/<id>/ when their directory exists; suites listed here but not yet delivered report not-run with their owner named. platform: 'any' runs on any host; 'macos' suites run only on macOS and are imported from committed out/<id>/results.json (produced by an approved native CI run — the existing iOS CI targets, or a workflow Sam approves from ci/pending-workflows/) elsewhere.
_bars_comment: Bars are the lead's choices recorded in PLAN.md, transcribed here; the runner owns them, not the suites. A suite-declared bar must match its registered bar or the metric fails with the reason; a bar registered nowhere fails outright. 'supporting' bars are registered checks that are not themselves PLAN bars (f_audit_screen_coverage is listed with no fixed bar: the suite may declare one, and the runner still derives the status from value + bar). Suite B implements its own bars per PLAN (authority: suite). D and E bar ids are provisional from PLAN wording: the delivering task may rename ids in the same PR that delivers the suite; bar values change only with a recorded PLAN reason.

learning.note: PLAN: owner suite implements the NDCG@10 / restriction / taste-shift bars (95% interval above 0 and at least +10% relative; 0 restriction violations; median shift recovery <= 6 cooks).
